# Framework Adapters — Shared Mental Model

> Per-framework specifics → adapters-react.md · adapters-vue.md · adapters-angular.md.

## shared architecture

- PATTERN: global singleton adapter registered at module load (React/Vue) or DI setup (Angular).
- FLOW: adapter registered → grid parses light DOM → user sets columns with framework components → `processConfig()` wraps components in bridge fns → grid calls renderer → bridge mounts component into the cell container.
- INVARIANT: the adapter MUST be registered BEFORE the grid parses light DOM. One adapter per app (singleton).
- INTERFACE: `processConfig`, `createComponentRenderer`, `createComponentEditor`, `releaseCell`, plus the methods listed in `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS`.
- DECIDED (#330): `beginBatch?()` / `endBatch?()` defer per-cell teardown across bulk `releaseCell` loops (`_clearRowPool`, `renderVisibleRows` pool-shrink, `renderInlineRow` pre-wipe). Calls NEST — the outermost `endBatch` flushes. Vue/Angular implement them as no-ops (already batched).
- DECIDED (#338/#340, reverted): adapter Context / `InjectionKey` / `InjectionToken` are plain module constants and MUST NOT be routed through `globalThis` (rationale in grid-core.md § shared-store). The micro-frontend `customElements.define` collision belongs to #339.

## adapter conformance

- OWNS: `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS` in `libs/grid/src/lib/core/adapter-conformance.ts`, re-exported from `public.ts`.
- INVARIANT: every adapter ships `<framework>-grid-adapter.conformance.spec.ts` that fails when a listed method is missing on the instance (React/Vue) or prototype (Angular — the ctor needs DI).
- INVARIANT: when core adds a hook it depends on, APPEND to `CORE_CONSUMED_ADAPTER_METHODS` so all three conformance specs go red.
- DECIDED: only the constant is exported from `public.ts`; helper fns stay internal (exporting them pushed `index.js` over budget). Each spec inlines a 2-line filter.

| Framework | Registration           | Event idiom                                     | Programmatic access                         |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| React     | global at module load  | props `onCellClick={d => …}` (`event-props.ts`) | `useGrid<TRow>()` hook                      |
| Vue       | global at module load  | emits `@cell-click="handler"`                   | `useGrid<TRow>()` composable (Ref wrappers) |
| Angular   | DI via `provideGrid()` | outputs `(cellClick)="handler($event)"`         | `injectGrid()`                              |

## adapter feature purity

- DECIDED (May 2026): adapter cores (`{react,vue,angular}-grid-adapter.ts`, `react-column-config.ts`) MUST NOT runtime-reference feature behaviour (type-only imports are fine). Runtime wiring lives in `features/<name>.ts` (React/Vue) or `features/<name>/src/` (Angular) secondary entries via registered bridges/hooks. Mirrors WC plugin discipline.
- DECIDED (#356 phase 7): the canonical cross-adapter registry surface is re-exported from each adapter's primary `index.ts`. The symbol list + adapter applicability lives in `.github/instructions/framework-adapters.instructions.md` ("Cross-adapter registry parity") — SSOT. INVARIANT: additive-contract only (never remove/rename); adding a registry to one adapter means mirroring it in the same PR with an identical export name + signature. Asserted by `*-grid-adapter.registry-parity.spec.ts` per adapter (Angular's spec also asserts React-only symbols are `undefined`, documenting the N/A intent).

## config-entry uniformity (component renderers via every entry point)

- INVARIANT: a framework component/JSX/VNode renderer inside `gridConfig.features.<name>` MUST be bridged to a vanilla DOM render fn IDENTICALLY to the per-feature prop/directive form. Same input → same plugin regardless of entry path. Tested per adapter.
- DECIDED: React/Vue bridge at the **feature factory** layer — `registerFeature(name, factory, { override: true })` wraps the vanilla factory with JSX/VNode→DOM bridging. WHY uniform: `grid.ts > #initializePlugins` → `resolveFeatures` → `createPluginsFromFeatures` → `createPluginFromFeature` → `getFeatureFactory(name)` is the SINGLE chokepoint core hits for every `config.features` entry, whether it arrived via props (→ `plugins[]`) or `gridConfig.features`. `processGridConfig` (React) / `mergedConfig` (Vue) spread `features` through untouched. Test: `features/grouping-columns.spec.tsx`.
- DECIDED: Angular bridges at the **preprocessor** layer (`registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor`), NOT a factory override — so the preprocessor MUST run on BOTH entry paths. `createFeaturePlugins` (directive path) ran it; the `gridConfig.features` path (`set gridConfig` → `processConfig` interceptor) did not until a `getFeatureConfigPreprocessor(name)` loop was added (Jun 2026). SYMPTOM before the fix: `TypeError: Class constructor … cannot be invoked without 'new'` at afterRender. Tests: `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts` "processGridConfig / processConfig".
- DOCS: all framework tabs lead with `gridConfig.features`; per-feature prop/directive/light-DOM is shown as an "Alternative" note, never removed.

## shell content wrappers (#352, #370)

- OWNS: React `Grid{Header,Toolbar}Content`, Vue `TbwGrid{Header,Toolbar}Content`, Angular `Grid{Header,Toolbar}Content` directives — wrapping `registerHeaderContent`/`registerToolbarContent` (specs co-located). Vue uses built-in `<Teleport>` (slot child of `<TbwGrid>`); Angular uses `host.closest('tbw-grid')`, NOT `injectGrid()` (descendants).
- INVARIANT: the render-callback cleanup is a **no-op**, and `register*` MUST `await grid.ready?.()` then guard unmount-during-await (React `unmounted` / Vue `cancelled` / Angular `destroyed`).
- INVARIANT (Angular): render MUST be idempotent — `createEmbeddedView` is not, so skip when `viewRef.rootNodes[0]` is still inside the container, else destroy the stale viewRef first. WHY: the grid reuses the SAME container by id across shell refreshes; real teardown destroys child state, and awaiting without the flag leaks the registration.
- DECIDED (#370, v3): wrappers route register/unregister through `grid.getPluginByName?.('shell')?.{register,unregister}{Header,Toolbar}Content`. The deprecated grid-element delegate fallback (`grid.register*Content`) is REMOVED — those delegates no longer exist (TS2339). Typing: a bare `import type { HeaderContentDefinition | ToolbarContentDefinition } from '@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/shell'` (NOT the package root) also activates the `PluginNameMap` augmentation so `getPluginByName('shell')` is typed — no cast. Files: `grid-react/src/lib/grid-{header,toolbar}-content.tsx`, `grid-vue/src/lib/TbwGrid{Header,Toolbar}Content.vue`, `grid-angular/src/lib/directives/grid-{header,toolbar}-content.directive.ts`. `GridToolPanel`/`TbwGridToolPanel` need no change (they render light-DOM `<tbw-grid-tool-panel>`; shell parses it).
- DECIDED (v3 enablement): each adapter ships an opt-in `features/shell` side-effect subpath (`@toolbox-web/grid-{react,vue,angular}/features/shell` → body `import '@toolbox-web/grid/features/shell'`). React/Vue add `'features/shell'` to `vite.config.mts` `build.lib.entry` + `import './shell'` in `src/features/index.ts`; Angular adds `features/shell/{ng-package.json,src/index.ts}` (auto-discovered, NO directive — shell is config-driven). All three `internal/feature-augmentations.ts` get `_ShellAugmentation`. GOTCHA: once `shell` is a global `FeatureConfig` key, BOTH React/Vue drift guards fire — `feature-props.ts` `_AssertFeaturePropsCoverCore` needs `shell?: boolean | ShellConfig`, and `feature-prop-keys.ts` `_AssertBuiltinCoversCore` needs `'shell'` in `_KnownBuiltinGaps` (NOT `BUILTIN_FEATURE_PROP_KEYS`) because shell is typed-but-not-runtime-extracted, like the stickyRows/rowDragDrop gaps. Angular has no feature-props guard. Verified by `features/shell{.spec.ts,/src/index.spec.ts}`.
- DECIDED (#260/#261/#262, v3): core no longer auto-registers ShellPlugin — shell resolves ONLY from `features:{shell}` or `plugins:[ShellPlugin]`; top-level `config.shell` alone does NOT enable it (it is merged by `ShellPlugin.processConfig` AFTER instantiation). Adapter demos therefore import `@toolbox-web/grid-{react,vue,angular}/features/shell` and move shell config under `features: { shell: {…} }`. WHY no library magic: shell is configured like any other feature. A child-feature detector returning `{ shell: true }` would be INSUFFICIENT — core drops unregistered feature names (TBW031), so the factory must be imported.
- DECIDED (#260/#261/#262, v3 — spec harnesses): shell-content `*ShellContent*.spec.*` harnesses route register/unregister through a MOCK shell plugin via `grid.getPluginByName('shell')`, not grid-element delegates. Angular reuses the same spies on both the element and the shell object; React/Vue expose a `shell` field on the harness.
- DECIDED (#260/#261/#262, v3 — mirrored core removals): (a) `@toolbox-web/grid/features/reorder-rows` DELETED → all three adapters dropped the `reorderRows` prop/`@Input`, `RowReorderConfig` import, `_ReorderRowsAugmentation`, the `features/reorder-rows` secondary entry (+ `vite.config.mts` entry / `features/index.ts` import for React/Vue, `features/reorder-rows/` folder + `typedoc.json` line for Angular, `BUILTIN_FEATURE_PROP_KEYS` for React/Vue). (b) `PinnedRowsConfig.customPanels` removed from core → adapter type is now `Omit<CorePinnedRowsConfig,'slots'> & { slots?: PinnedRowSlot[] }`; bridges only `slots[]`. (c) shell type aliases import from `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/shell`.
- GOTCHA: `ToolPanelDefinition.title` is OPTIONAL as of #430 (plugin API and the `<tbw-grid-tool-panel>` parser both accept a missing title; a title-less single panel skips its accordion header). Adapter inputs match: React `GridToolPanelProps.title?`, Angular `GridToolPanel.title = input<string>()`, Vue `title?` (resolves to `''`).

## bridge registries (append-only, populated by side-effect imports)

| Registry                                                                       | Module                                                                | Installed by                                                                               | Purpose                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `registerEditorMountHook` / `notifyEditorMounted`                              | `editor-mount-hooks.ts` (all 3)                                       | `features/editing`                                                                         | `before-edit-close` → native `.blur()` on the focused input                                                                               |
| `registerFilterPanelTypeDefaultBridge`                                         | each adapter                                                          | `features/filtering`                                                                       | wraps the user `filterPanelRenderer` in the framework render path                                                                         |
| `registerDetailRendererBridge` / `registerResponsiveCardRendererBridge`        | `{react,vue}-grid-adapter.ts` / Angular `internal/feature-bridges.ts` | `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`                                            | turns a user template/component into a renderer fn; the adapter method becomes a thin delegate                                            |
| `registerPostMountRefresh(name, fn)` / `notifyPostMount`                       | `post-mount-refresh-hooks.ts` (React + Vue)                           | `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`                                            | feature-keyed kick after framework children commit, so plugins created pre-children pick up renderers                                     |
| `registerChildFeatureDetector(name, fn)` / `detectChildFeatures`               | `child-feature-detector.ts` (**React only**)                          | built-ins pre-registered at `data-grid.tsx` module load                                    | scans React children by `displayName`, returns partial `FeatureProps` to auto-enable plugins                                              |
| `registerFeaturePropKey(name)` / `getFeaturePropKeys`                          | `feature-prop-keys.ts` (React + Vue)                                  | module-load self-registration of every built-in key                                        | canonical list of `FeatureProps` keys extracted from `...rest`/declared props before `createPluginsFromFeatures`                          |
| `registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor(name, fn)` / `getFeatureConfigPreprocessor` | `internal/feature-extensions.ts` (**Angular only**)                   | `features/{grouping-columns,grouping-rows,pinned-rows,master-detail,responsive,filtering}` | bridges Angular `TemplateRef`/`Component` shapes in feature config to core renderer fns; invoked uniformly by `Grid.createFeaturePlugins` |
| `registerTemplateBridge` (**Angular only**)                                    | `internal/feature-extensions.ts`                                      | `features/master-detail`, `features/responsive`                                            | wires `<tbw-grid-detail>` / `<tbw-grid-responsive-card>` templates in `ngAfterContentInit`                                                |

- DECIDED (#356 phase 7): each adapter ships ONLY the registries its shell actually invokes — React adds `registerChildFeatureDetector`; Vue omits it (slots carry templates, not feature signals); Angular has neither the detector nor `registerFeaturePropKey`/`registerPostMountRefresh` (per-feature `@Input()` directives, no `{...rest}` spread; `ngAfterContentInit` covers post-mount). RULED OUT: "ship-without-caller for API parity" — an uncalled registry is dead code. The asymmetry is framework-shaped, not drift.
- INVARIANT: features import from the adapter's PRIMARY entry (registry hooks + types); the primary entry MUST NOT import from feature secondary entries (build cycle).
- INVARIANT: spec files exercising bridge behaviour MUST side-effect-import `'../features/<name>'` at the top, mirroring real consumers — otherwise the bridge is null and methods return `undefined`.
- DECIDED: `createToolPanelRenderer` stays on the adapter (CORE primitive — `shell.ts` parses `<tbw-grid-tool-panel>` and calls it). `createEditor`/`createRenderer` stay on the adapter (per-cell primitives). `createFilterPanelRenderer` stays inline (generic node-to-container wrap; the only filter dependency is type-only).
- DECIDED (#354): adapter `pinned-rows` slot-renderer wrappers MUST cache the host element per renderer across calls. WHY: `PinnedRowsPlugin.renderPanelSlot` reference-checks renderer outputs in a `rowOutputsCache` WeakMap to skip row rebuilds; a fresh host each call forces React/Vue unmount-remount and Angular re-create. React/Vue closure-cache `{host, portalKey}` → `renderToContainer(host, node, key)`, with a `PinnedRowsPluginWithCleanup` subclass overriding `detach()` to `removeFromContainer`; Angular closure-caches `{hostElement, componentRef}` → `setInput() + detectChanges()`. Specs: `libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/features/pinned-rows.spec.{tsx,ts}`, `libs/grid-angular/features/pinned-rows/src/cached-panel-renderer.spec.ts` (pure helper extracted from `index.ts` to avoid DI mocking).
- DECIDED (#353): feature configs carrying renderer callbacks expose adapter-typed wrappers so consumers can return framework-native nodes: `Omit<CoreConfig,'rendererProp'> & { rendererProp?: CoreConfig['rendererProp'] | FrameworkReturn }`. NAMING POLICY: adapters re-export the widened type under the SAME canonical name as the core type using a `Core*` import alias (mirrors `GridConfig`/`DataGridElement`). Covers React `lib/feature-props.ts` (`FilterConfig`, `ColumnGroupDefinition`, `GroupingColumnsConfig`, `GroupingRowsConfig`, `PanelRender`/`PanelSlot`/`PinnedRowSlot`/`PinnedRowsConfig`/`ZonedPanelRender`, `MasterDetailConfig`, `ResponsivePluginConfig`), Vue's `VNode` mirror, and Angular per-feature directives widened with `| Type<unknown>`. The legacy `React*`/`Vue*`/`Angular*` prefixed names were REMOVED in the 3.0 cleanup. RUNTIME: React/Vue use a `createPluginFromFeature` factory override (subclass `*PluginWithCleanup` tracks portal/teleport keys, overrides `detach()` → `removeFromContainer(key)`); Angular uses `registerFeatureConfigPreprocessor` + `adapter.mountComponentRenderer`.
  - INVARIANT: spec assertions read `plugin.userConfig`, NOT `plugin.config` (`config` is populated only post-`attach()`, `base-plugin.ts`).
  - INVARIANT: Angular spec files MUST `import '@angular/compiler';` before importing the side-effect feature module, else `@angular/forms` triggers `JIT compilation failed for PlatformLocation`.
  - INVARIANT: when an adapter feature file imports core types AND re-exports the widened version under the same name, alias the core import as `Core*`.

## event props (drift-safety pattern)

- OWNS: React `EventProps<TRow>` + `EVENT_PROP_MAP` (`libs/grid-react/src/lib/event-props.ts`, bidirectional `satisfies`); Vue `EVENT_MAP` + `defineEmits` (`TbwGrid.vue`, forward-only `_emitsCoverCore`); Angular `output<T>()` + `eventOutputMap` (`directives/grid.directive.ts`, value-side `satisfies` + forward-only `_assertEventOutputMapCoversCore`).
- INVARIANT: adding a `DataGridEventMap` entry wires ALL THREE. Each adapter has its own `_IntentionallyOmittedEvents` union that must be widened to consciously skip an event.
- INVARIANT: NEVER widen `satisfies` to silence a complaint — the complaint IS the feature. Either drop the prop or add the missing `declare module '../../core/types'` augmentation. When `satisfies` rejects an event, check emit sites (`grep "_emit("`) — plugins and the registry can diverge silently.
- INVARIANT (guard shape): a drift guard MUST be a real VALUE assignment — `const _x: [Missing] extends [never] ? true : ['msg', Missing] = true;`. A `declare private x: <conditional>` or a bare `type _Assert = …` alias is NEVER checked and is silently inert (see adapters-angular.md).
- INVARIANT: missing core public exports surface as an ANGULAR build failure (not Vue/React) — Angular's `@toolbox-web/grid/all` deep import only sees `libs/grid/src/public.ts`, so new event detail types must be re-exported there.
- GOTCHA (Vue enforcement): `nx build grid-vue` runs `vite-plugin-dts`, which PRINTS SFC type errors (`error TS2322`) but exits 0 — the Vue guard is advisory at build time (hard error in-editor via Volar). Making it blocking needs a `vue-tsc` devDependency + `typecheck` target (plain `tsc` cannot parse `.vue`). React HAS a real blocking `typecheck` target (`bunx tsc -p libs/grid-react/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit`, wired into `build.dependsOn`); Angular's is blocked by ng-packagr.
- DECIDED: `EventProps` is flat (one entry per event, even paired `onUndo`/`onRedo` — a tried `onUndoRedo` bound to a non-emitted `'undo-redo'`). Hand-maintained interface + `satisfies`, NOT a mapped type (TypeDoc renders mapped types as `unknown`).
- TENSION (Angular): `eventOutputMap` keys are not statically tied to the `output<T>()` fields — a forgotten entry is a silent runtime bug.
- GOTCHA (Angular `_intentionallyOmittedEvents`): the guard only proves the union COVERS the event map — it cannot prove the stated rationale is still true. A Jul 2026 audit found `tree-expand` + all three `tree-load-*` parked there under "the Angular adapter has no per-feature tree directive yet" while `features/tree/src/grid-tree.directive.ts` already existed and claimed `tree-expand`. `tree-load-start/end/error` were genuinely unreachable in Angular while React/Vue had them. Fixed by adding the three outputs to `GridTreeDirective`. When auditing parity, re-verify each omission's REASON, not just that the guard compiles.
- DECIDED (Jul 2026): Angular's event split — 11 grid-level events on `Grid`, the other 36 on per-feature directives — is idiomatic, NOT a parity gap. React/Vue expose all 47 on the root component (verified identical, same 3 internal-only omissions: `mount-external-editor`, `mount-external-view`, `column-reorder-request`).

## `before-edit-close` blur bridge

- DECIDED: editor `before-edit-close` → native `.blur()` on the focused input/textarea/select. WHY: Tab and programmatic row exits rebuild cell DOM synchronously, so `onBlur={commit}` / `@blur` / `(blur)` would lose pending input. Native `.blur()`, NOT a synthetic `FocusEvent` (React 17+ delegates focus via bubbling `focusout`). Angular parallel: `BaseGridEditor.onBeforeEditClose()`.
- DECIDED (#249): the bridge wires BOTH the slot/JSX `createEditor` path AND the config-path wrappers — React `wrapReactEditor`; Vue `createConfigVNodeEditor`/`createConfigComponentEditor`/`createTypeEditor`; Angular `createComponentEditor` + template `createEditor`. Tab from the last cell runs `#exitRowEdit(currentRow,false)` → `beginBulkEdit(nextRow)` synchronously, so the focused input never blurs naturally. Grid resolved lazily via `queueMicrotask`.
- CLEANUP: React threads `unsub` through `mountedPortals` (`cleanupConfigRootsIn`); Vue/Angular store it in an `editorMountTeardowns` Map (container/host-keyed), swept in `releaseCell` + `destroy()`.
- DECIDED: install moved out of the adapter into the `editor-mount-hooks.ts` notifier (`attachBeforeEditCloseFlush` → `runEditorMountHooks`); `features/editing` registers it.
- TESTS: `react-column-config.spec.ts > flushes the focused input on before-edit-close`; `vue-grid-adapter.spec.ts > … for config-based VNode editor`; `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts > before-edit-close blur bridge`.

## `releaseCell` DOM-recycle invariant (#250)

- DECIDED: core MUST call `grid.__frameworkAdapter?.releaseCell?.(cell)` BEFORE any sync wipe (`innerHTML=''` / `replaceChildren()`) of a cell that may hold adapter-managed renderer DOM. Without it the framework tree references orphans and the next commit throws `NotFoundError: removeChild`.
- COVERED: `editor-injection.ts` (open editor); `renderVisibleRows` pool-shrink (`core/internal/rows.ts`); `_clearRowPool` (`grid.ts`). All guarded by `cell.firstElementChild`.
- KNOWN WEAKNESS: `GroupingRowsPlugin.ts` and `pinned-rows.ts` have `rowEl.innerHTML=''` paths that do NOT call `releaseCell` first (they rely on `PortalBoundary` or equivalent).
- TESTS: `rows.spec.ts > releases cells when pool shrinks`, plus per-adapter coverage.

## feature-prop bridging (gh #356)

Feature props auto-load plugins: React `<DataGrid selection="range" editing="dblclick" />`, Vue `<TbwGrid :selection="'range'" />`, Angular `<tbw-grid [selection]="'range'">`. MECHANISM: feature props → `createPluginsFromFeatures()` → factories → `gridConfig.plugins`.

- DECIDED: all three adapters derive `FeatureName = Exclude<keyof FeatureConfig, '__brand'>` from core's augmentable interface, so third-party features auto-join. Strict-additive enforced by `feature-registry.spec.ts` in each adapter.
- DECIDED (Angular, ng-packagr): partial compilation needs every `@toolbox-web/grid/features/*` module on its type graph at emit. SOLUTION: a types-only barrel `internal/feature-augmentations.ts` (one `import type {} from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'` per feature), pulled by `feature-registry.ts` via a **bare** `import './internal/feature-augmentations'` (NOT `import type {}` — tsc preserves bare imports through emit so ng-packagr's rollup-of-dts sees the augmenting modules). SYMPTOM when wrong: `TS2345: Argument of type '"selection"' is not assignable to parameter of type 'never'` (FeatureName collapsed to `never`).
- DECIDED (May 2026, typedoc): React/Vue MIRROR that barrel with `export type { _Augmentation as _<Name>Augmentation } from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'`. WHY: `nx build` uses esbuild (transpile-only) so the gap never surfaced, but `nx typedoc` runs `tsc --strict` over an entry-point-only program where `keyof FeatureConfig` collapses to whatever is transitively imported → `TS2322: Type '"filtering"' is not assignable to type 'FeatureName'`. **INVARIANT: any new core feature MUST be appended to ALL THREE `internal/feature-augmentations.ts` files in the same PR.** Verify: `bun nx run-many -t typedoc -p grid-react,grid-vue,grid-angular`.
- DECIDED (Jun 2026, dist-consumer augmentation): a BARE `import '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'` is STRIPPED from the emitted `.d.ts` by vite-plugin-dts (works only when the consumer path-maps to SOURCE); a NAMED `export type { _Augmentation as _<Name>Augmentation } from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'` SURVIVES emit and drags the augmenting module onto the consumer's type graph. **INVARIANT: every `libs/grid-{react,vue}/src/features/*.ts` subpath MUST carry that named re-export from its CORE `features/<name>` subpath** (delegators keep their bare runtime import too; grouping-columns/rows re-export from the core `features/grouping-*` subpath, NOT the plugin), or dist consumers importing only that subpath hit TS2353. The `internal/feature-augmentations.ts` barrel does NOT rescue dist consumers. Original bug: `features/filtering.ts` imported only the PLUGIN, so `filtering?` was missing from `FeatureConfig`. Angular already does both (ng-packagr preserves bare imports).
- DECIDED: `feature-prop-keys.ts` stores `Set<FeatureName>` with a cached frozen-array snapshot rebuilt lazily on mutation (`<DataGrid>`/`<TbwGrid>` call `getFeaturePropKeys()` on every render). Known gaps kept: Vue BUILTIN omits `rowDragDrop`; BOTH omit `stickyRows`; both list `shell` in `_KnownBuiltinGaps`. Guard `_AssertBuiltinCoversCore` enforces `BUILTIN ⊇ keyof FeatureConfig` minus the `_KnownBuiltinGaps` allowlist. React↔Vue drift is machine-checked by `grid-react/src/lib/feature-prop-keys.parity.spec.ts` (reads BOTH files as **text** via `readFileSync` — adapter↔adapter imports are ESLint-banned; asserts BUILTIN lists match modulo `ACCEPTED_DIVERGENCE = ['rowDragDrop']`, that `BUILTIN ∪ gaps` is the same universe, and that no key sits in both lists). Adding/removing a BUILTIN key in one adapter now fails that spec — update the allowlist deliberately, never silently.
- TENSION: `rowDragDrop` is an unresolved public-API parity gap, not just a list difference. Both adapters ship `src/features/row-drag-drop.ts`, but only React extracts the prop, so `<DataGrid rowDragDrop={…}>` works and `<TbwGrid :row-drag-drop="…">` does not. Closing it means adding the key to Vue BUILTIN and dropping it from Vue's `_KnownBuiltinGaps` + the spec allowlist.
- DECIDED: React built-in child-feature detectors are PRE-REGISTERED at `data-grid.tsx` module load (NOT via feature side-effect imports) so users rendering `<GridDetailPanel>` without importing `features/master-detail` keep working.
- TESTS: `post-mount-refresh-hooks.spec.ts`, `child-feature-detector.spec.ts`, `feature-prop-keys.spec.ts`, `feature-registry.spec.ts` (superset assertion in all 3).

## three-way parity

- STATE (verified Jul 2026 by diffing the real surfaces): 25/25 feature subpath entry points — names byte-identical across React `src/features/*.ts`, Vue `src/features/*.ts`, Angular `features/*/`. 5/5 per-feature accessors identical after `useGridX`↔`injectGridX` normalization. 47/47 events (React/Vue on the root component; Angular split 11 root + 36 feature-directive). Feature prop keys: React 23, Vue 22 (`_KnownBuiltinGaps`: Vue omits `rowDragDrop`; both omit `stickyRows` + `shell`).
- INVARIANT: a public export added to one adapter is mirrored in the SAME PR; `index.ts` is the canonical surface. `AllFeatureProps<TRow>` shape must stay identical React/Vue.
- DECIDED (#289): cell/editor context generics use asymmetric defaults `TRow = unknown`, `TValue = any` (Vue `CellSlotProps`/`EditorSlotProps`/`GridCellContext`/`GridEditorContext`; React `GridCellContext`/`GridEditorContext`). WHY: `unknown` for row safety; `any` for `TValue` unblocks single-generic `CellSlotProps<MyRow>` (narrowing is awkward in templates). Tests: `slot-types.spec.ts`, `context-types.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#438, nested dotted-path fields): all three adapters inherit nested-path `field` support automatically (their `ColumnConfig` `Omit`s only renderers, so `field` flows from core). Each gained a defaulted `TField extends string = ColumnFieldKey<TRow>` generic so strict opt-in composes with adapter renderers (`GridConfig<Deal, NestedPaths<Deal>>`). GOTCHA: adapters alias core `ColumnConfig` as `BaseColumnConfig`, and core `ColumnConfig<TRow, TField>` has only **2** params (unlike core `BaseColumnConfig<TRow, TValue, TField>`), so write `extends Omit<BaseColumnConfig<TRow, TField>, …>` — `<TRow, any, TField>` fails ng-packagr with `TS2707`. `ColumnFieldKey`/`NestedPaths` re-exported from all three `index.ts`. Context `field` types are all `string`. Tests: `nested-field-parity.spec.ts` per adapter.
- DECIDED (v3, #261/#262): React and Vue both dropped `SSRProps`/`ssr` → `AllFeatureProps<TRow> = FeatureProps<TRow>` in both. React also removed the `ssr` destructure + `featurePlugins` skip in `data-grid.tsx`; Vue's removal was surface-only (`TbwGrid.vue` iterates `getFeaturePropKeys()`). Vue also removed the deprecated `makeFlushFocusedInput` re-export from `vue-grid-adapter.ts`.
- TENSION: idiomatic differences are NOT parity gaps (`<DataGrid>` vs `<TbwGrid>`, render props vs slots, `GridElementContext` vs `GRID_ELEMENT_KEY`, `PortalManager` vs `TeleportManager`).

## cross-adapter tensions

- REGISTRATION TIMING: React/Vue auto-register at module load (sync); Angular requires explicit DI setup.
- WEAKMAP FALLBACK: dual lookup (WeakMap → field name → factory) is needed because framework re-renders create new DOM elements.
- PORTAL/TELEPORT OVERHEAD: mounting framework components into web-component cells requires a bridge layer managing lifecycle outside the framework's component tree.
